Jemand's Disease seems an invention of this author http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%98%BF%E5%88%80%E7%94%B0%E9%AB%98 which he declared free for anyone to use, though I can't find any evidence beyond this http://www.berrys-cafe.jp/pc/reader/page.htm?chapterId=1412804
